corrections.text: The article states that, in the Herald's comparison of the Beta2 and Beta1 changelogs, '19 IDs appear in both lists'. The count of 19 includes KT-79212, which is a changelog entry in one release but appears in the other only as a mention inside another entry's text. Counting changelog list entries, 18 KT issue IDs appear in both changelogs, or 24 entries when six Google issue-tracker (b/) IDs are included.
